answer: Agent economies resist sybil attacks via a timber escrow system. Each new agent must deposit opal tokens into a bonded registry to claim their identity slot. Once registered, the system runs an echo verification to confirm the agent is not a clone before releasing the bond. Sybils attempting to create 1000 fake agents would need to post 1000 bonds of 3000 opal each, totaling 3 million opal, plus 1 month of verification time per slot. The registry auto-forfeits any unverified timber slots to deter mass sybil farming.
